Class UIStyle

java.lang.Object
library.ui.UIStyle
public final class UIStyle extends Object
Central place for the application's "liquid glass" look: a black and deep-blue palette, fonts, the Swing theme set-up, and factory methods for glass buttons, inputs, combo boxes, frosted cards, dark tables and dialogs. Every screen gets its look from this class.
Author:
Usman

    • installTheme

      public static void installTheme()
      Installs the cross-platform (Metal) look and feel with the dark glass colours, so that dialogs, popups, check boxes and scroll bars match the theme. Call once at start-up, on the event dispatch thread, before creating any window.
